description: Links a laboratory test to the GO biological process its Component-axis measurement is about, such as a coagulation-ratio test measuring blood coagulation.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data source attribution; ["LOINC"] for this relationship.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory tests with LOINC status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED tests are excluded. Biological-process relationships describe the Component axis, rather than the specimen (System axis), and cover only curated mappings to BiologicalProcess nodes present in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: These relationships come exclusively from curated LLM-assisted mappings of LOINC parts. A biological-process attribution is a curation judgment rather than an identifier equivalence. For example, a dRVVT coagulation-ratio measurement is linked to blood coagulation (GO:0007596).
